action_label: Map each Shopify variant to a class and stem count
description:
One row per Shopify variant: class (Box, Fee or Packaging) and stem count. A new box tier is a new row, not code.

Matching is by **variant id, not SKU** — every product on this store has a null SKU. Only `Box` rows are allocated; fee and packaging lines ride along and are ignored by fulfilment. Seeding guesses from the live catalogue and lets anything unrecognised through as a zero-stem Box, so review the rows afterwards.
name: Map Shopify Products
